body.query: How much did Neros raise in its latest funding round?

results.title: Neros Raises $250M Series C at $2.5B Valuation to Scale Autonomous and Interceptor Drone Programs
highlights: TORRANCE, California — August 11, 2026 — Neros Technologies has announced a $250M Series C at a post money valuation of $2.5B co-led by Sequoia Capital and American Strategic Technology Fund (ASTF) with participation by Interlagos, Valor Equity Partners, Allen & Company, Thiel Capital, Spark Capital, and Dylan Field.

# Neros Raises $250M, Triples Worth to $2.5B
...
- Neros closed a $250 million funding round, tripling its valuation to $2.5 billion.
- The company aims to scale drone production from 14,000 to one million units per year by 2028.
- Sequoia Capital co-led the round with American Strategic Technology Fund, with Thiel Capital also participating.
...
That urgency just paid off in a big way. Neros secured $250 million in new financing, an infusion that boosted its worth threefold to $2.5 billion. Sequoia Capital co-led the round with American Strategic Technology Fund, and Thiel Capital joined in as well.
